Live pulse — measured in this browser

Every tracked market's order book, re-read from Kalshi's public demo API while this page is open. A new row appears whenever a contract's quote mid moves ≥ $0.10 either way since the last reading. Same quote-integrity rule as the collector: a one-sided or wide book is refused and the reason is shown.

Live rows are measured from GET /markets/orderbooks ↗ (one request per refresh, documented cap 100 markets) and use the documented book semantics (best bid = last level, YES ask = 1.00 − best NO bid). They are not the collector's rows: the collector compares Kalshi's 1-minute candle quotes, these compare successive readings taken by this tab. Nothing is written back to the site, and no cause is ever claimed for a move.
